tools.name: browse_category
tools.description: List the published products in a category and its subcategories, 24 per page, optionally narrowed by specification filters (such as resistance or package). The result lists the filters the category offers and their values.

tools.name: create_basket_link
tools.description: Make a link that opens NerdMarket with these packs (SKU and quantity) listed, ready for the person to check and add to their basket with one button, then pay at checkout. Nothing is added or bought until they press it. Also says whether each line can be added now and the total.

tools.name: delivery_and_returns
tools.description: Get delivery options and prices, and links to the shop's delivery, returns, terms and contact pages.

tools.name: get_product
tools.description: Get a published product: description, every pack size with its price including VAT and how many packs are in stock (exact up to 50), specifications, datasheets and photos.

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: List the shop's categories that have published products, with their parents.

tools.name: search_products
tools.description: Search NerdMarket's published products by words, part number (MPN), barcode (GTIN) or SKU. Returns up to 24 products per page with price and stock state.
